in_marathi.name: Vigneshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sacred Path
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vigneshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is the ruler and guardian of the sacred path leading to salvation and spiritual enlightenment.

in_bengali.name: Vigneshwar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Sacred Path
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vigneshwar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is the ruler and guardian of the sacred path leading to salvation and spiritual enlightenment.
